en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Licking the Lips.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks licked their lips while eating.
… [The Buddha said: “‘I shall not lick my lips while eating’—this training is to be observed.
One must not lick one’s lips while eating.
Whoever, out of disrespect, licks his lips while eating, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first offender":
thus ends the fourth training rule.
